name: Hitozuma Sex ~Shiranu Ma ni Otosareteita Ai Suru Tsuma~
original_name: 人妻セックス ～知らぬ間に堕とされていた愛する妻～
source:
Yuuki and his wife, Iori, entered an arranged marriage through their father's acquaintance. Both being of a calm disposition, they enjoyed a leisurely yet blissful married life. 

One day, Yuki's boss, Ryou, relocates to a room near where Yuki and his wife reside. As Yuki had already established a good rapport with Ryo at work, he didn't give it much thought. Little did he know that this seemingly minor occurrence would soon throw their lives into turmoil...

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=1085633]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
Yuuki和他的妻子Iori通过父亲的熟人缔结了包办婚姻。两人性格沉稳，婚姻生活悠闲而幸福。

有一天，Yuki的老板Ryou搬到了Yuki和他妻子居住的地方附近的一间房间。由于由希在工作中已经和亮建立了良好的关系，所以他没有多想。殊不知，这件看似微不足道的小事，却很快让他们的生活陷入混乱……
